name: cellular-automaton
description: Conway's Game of Life: a pure TypeScript domain and a static browser application

scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm smoke:domain && pnpm build
scripts.check:hexagon: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.domain.json && vitest run domain application
scripts.smoke:domain: node --experimental-strip-types --input-type=module -e "import * as domain from './domain/index.ts'; const surface = Object.keys(domain).sort().join(' '); const expected = 'Generation Pattern PatternName Position Ruleset Topology parseCells'; if (surface !== expected) { throw new Error('the domain loaded its surface as [' + surface + '] rather than [' + expected + ']'); }"
